name: The Verge Township
designRule: macro geography guides placement; HD-ISO-V1 assets determine close-camera fidelity

districts.character: large masonry compounds, courtyards, service alleys, perimeter walls
hospital, municipal blocks, waterfront service road, decayed public buildings
detached houses, duplexes, church streets, cul-de-sacs, neglected yards
broad four-way junctions, pharmacy, grocery, municipal offices, apartments
continuous shopfronts, service alleys, parking, garages, faded signage
older homes, church, cemetery edge, narrow streets, memorial green
warehouses, workshops, tanks, loading yards, substations, truck access
motel, derelict retail, trailers, scrub, broken road edges, forest encroachment

corridors.role: dense commercial loop with service alleys
quiet residential descent toward cemetery ridge

landmarkRules.navigationPrinciple: major landmarks create silhouettes and route memory before minimap dependence

greylineHooks.restraint: emptier streets, distant fog, severe quiet, hard landmark silhouettes
greylineHooks.flux: maximum spatial legibility and truthful environmental cues
greylineHooks.compulsion: denser clutter, harsher lights, peripheral motion and signage instability
greylineHooks.samsarra: same geography with corrupted facade layers, impossible shadow, repetition and contamination
